violation_type.title: Store Pest Control Products According to Label (26 TAC §747.3225(4))
violation_type.short_title: Store Pest Control Products According to Label
violation_type.typical_finding: One bottle of raid was observed in the kitchen on top of the counter.     Note: Photos were taken. This item was removed during inspection.

finding_variants.text: One bottle of raid was observed in the kitchen on top of the counter.     Note: Photos were taken. This item was removed during inspection.
Pest control products observed in the backyard.     This was corrected when the products were removed from the backyard.

A mosquito and fly killer spray was placed on a shelf next to the day care area and was not stored in a cool dry place according to the label directions. A photo was taken.    This was corrected at inspection when it was removed and stored away in a cabinet.
There were various pest control products, including insect killer observed that are accessible to children near the outdoor/activity space.
